## serializeAuditRecord() function

Serialize a [PermissionDeniedAuditRecord](./core.permissiondeniedauditrecord.md)<!-- -->: its attribution and the timestamp as an ISO-8601 string, and nothing else.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function serializeAuditRecord(
  record: PermissionDeniedAuditRecord
): SerializedPermissionDeniedAuditRecord
```
